init.title: Configure Imou Life
init.description:
Alarm push: **{push_state}** · Alarm pictures: **{decrypt_state}** · Record on alarm: **{record_state}** · Status polling: **{polling_state}**

Each page saves on submit and comes back here. Alarm pictures and Record on alarm only do anything while alarm push is on.

general_settings.title: Status polling and camera defaults
general_settings.description: How often Home Assistant refreshes device status, plus the live stream and PTZ defaults every camera on this account starts from.

data_description.enable_polling: Turn off to skip periodic cloud refreshes. Entity states may become outdated. Setup and reload still fetch the device list once. When event push is on and subscribe types include IoT device messages, thing-model device *properties* are not refreshed on this interval (setup and reload still take one snapshot). Online status, PaaS abilities, and service-backed entities still poll.
data_description.update_interval: Default 300s (5 minutes), range 30–900s. Ignored when polling is off.

camera_defaults.name: Camera defaults
camera_defaults.description: Live stream and PTZ defaults for this account.

data_description.download_snap_wait_time: The camera has to take the snapshot and upload it before Imou can serve it. This is how long Home Assistant waits before fetching. Raise it if snapshots come back stale or empty. Default 3s.
data_description.live_resolution: HD = high definition, SD = standard. Used for the Live camera entity.
data_description.rotation_duration: How far one press of a PTZ direction button moves, as movement time. Default 500ms.

event_push.title: Alarm push and notifications
event_push.description: {lan_hint}Receive cloud alarms via webhook. Suggested callback: {suggested_url}

data_description.enable_event_push: Imou cloud POSTs alarms to this Home Assistant webhook. Alarms also sync to the Imou Life app.
data_description.webhook_url: Required when event push is on. Must be reachable from the internet; if the suggested address is not, change only the hostname and port.
data_description.event_push_types: Which cloud messages Home Assistant should receive.

notifications.name: Notify on alarm
notifications.description: Optional. Leave empty to use automations only.

data_description.notify_services: Registered notify services on this Home Assistant. One message per alarm. Turn off **Notify on alarm** on a device page to skip that device. To put the alarm picture in these messages, see **Alarm pictures**.

alarm_image_decrypt.title: Alarm pictures

data.attach_decrypted_thumbnail: Show the picture in alarm notifications

data_description.attach_decrypted_thumbnail: Needs Home Assistant's external URL (Settings → System → Network) for phones off the LAN. Pictures are saved unauthenticated under /local/imou_life/thumbs/ for about 24 hours. Passwords stay on this Home Assistant and are used only to decrypt.
data_description.default_device_password: Fallback for devices that do not have their own password below.
data_description.clear_default_device_password: Deletes the stored default. Per-device passwords are unchanged.

local_recording.title: Record on alarm
local_recording.description: {push_hint}Records a short clip from the cloud stream after an alarm. Per-camera **Record on alarm** is on each device page.

data_description.local_record_path: Example: /media/imou. Leave empty to skip. Folder must be in allowlist_external_dirs.
data_description.local_record_duration: Post-alarm clip length. Default 60s, range 15–180s. Uses live-stream quota.

select_poll_devices.title: Choose devices to poll
select_poll_devices.description: Found {device_count} device(s). Unselected devices stay in Home Assistant but are not polled.

no_devices_menu.title: No devices found
no_devices_menu.description: This account has no Imou devices yet. Bind a device now, or save without binding.

devices_unavailable.title: Could not reach the Imou cloud
devices_unavailable.description:
The device list could not be fetched: {error}

You can try again, or save your other changes and leave the device selection as it is.

bind_device.title: Bind a new device
bind_device.description: Enter the device serial number and binding code from the Imou Life app or device label.

data_description.device_id: Serial number (SN) printed on the device or shown in the Imou Life app
data_description.code: Optional. Leave empty if the device does not require a binding code

options.push_off: Alarm push is off, so nothing on this page takes effect yet. Turn it on under Configure → Alarm push and notifications.
options.callback_not_public: This address is only reachable on your local network, so the Imou cloud cannot POST alarms to it and phones off the LAN cannot load alarm pictures. Set an internet-reachable address under Settings → System → Network → Home Assistant URL, or type the address your reverse proxy exposes.

options.alarm: Device alarms (smoke, gas, human, picture change, etc.)
options.iot: IoT device messages. When this is selected and event push is on, thing-model devices update switches/sensors/arming from iotProperty immediately and skip the interval property poll. Turn event push off or uncheck this to poll those properties again.

options.unsupported: not supported (needs linux x86-64; this host is {arch})
options.missing: decrypt libraries missing ({found}/2 found). Copy {client_so} and {sdk_so} into {native_dir}

stream_source_failed.message: Could not get the live stream URL from Imou: {error}

camera_image_failed.message: Could not get a snapshot from Imou: {error}

motion_detection_unsupported.message: {name} does not support picture-change or human detection, so motion detection cannot be turned on or off.

not_a_ptz_button.message: {entity_id} is not a PTZ button, so it cannot be moved. Target a PTZ direction button instead.

remove_device_missing_id.message: Cannot remove device {name}: missing Imou device id.

remove_device_has_siblings.message: Cannot remove {name}: it is one channel of Imou device {device_id}, which also covers {siblings}. Deselect the whole device in the integration options to stop polling it, or disable this channel's entities to hide it.

remove_device_no_runtime.message: Cannot remove device {name}: integration is not loaded.
